description: A Polymarket wallet's highlight vs its whole record, from Polymarket's own public data: this week / 30 days / all-time results and ranks, max drawdown, and stats over resolved positions (hit rate, average win vs loss, biggest win and loss, how much of the profit came from the top 3 markets). Use for 'is this Polymarket trader actually good?' or when someone shares a viral Polymarket wallet. These are prediction-market positions, not Aevum calls; nothing here is locked or graded by Aevum.
name: check_polymarket_wallet
title: Check a Polymarket wallet
